en.title: GTA 6 Shatters Records, But User Reviews Spark Controversy
en.summary: Despite a historic critical reception, Grand Theft Auto VI is facing a wave of negative user scores on Metacritic. This stark contrast highlights a growing divide between critical acclaim and player sentiment.
en.body:
In a development that has left many scratching their heads, **Grand Theft Auto VI** is experiencing a peculiar phenomenon: review bombing, despite achieving what is arguably the most celebrated critical launch in video game history. Metacritic, the aggregator of professional reviews, showcases **GTA 6** with an astonishing 99 out of 100, based on over 150 critic scores. This places it firmly as the highest-rated game of all time, a testament to Rockstar Games' meticulous craft and vision.

However, this near-universal critical adoration stands in stark opposition to the reception from players. As of this writing, the user score on Metacritic hovers around a 'Mixed or Average' 5.4. This figure is even lower on the PlayStation Store, where it sits at a 4.84 based on a staggering 170,000 reviews. The reasons cited by some players for these low scores are varied, ranging from disappointment with the game's 30fps performance, claims that the series has become 'woke,' to finding the narrative 'horrible.' It's particularly noteworthy that these user reviews began appearing even before the game officially hit store shelves, a move that has led Metacritic to actively remove what it deems fake or malicious submissions.

## The Disconnect Between Critics and Players

The sheer magnitude of the critical success for **GTA 6** makes the user score disparity all the more striking. While critics laud the game for its groundbreaking achievements in open-world design, storytelling, and technical prowess, a segment of the player base appears to be expressing significant dissatisfaction. This isn't the first time a highly anticipated game has faced user backlash, but the intensity and timing—so close to its record-breaking critical debut—are unusual. The speed at which negative reviews materialized, coupled with Metacritic's intervention, suggests a coordinated effort by some to deliberately lower the game's public perception, regardless of its actual quality.

## Fan Reactions and Future Implications

For passionate fans who have followed the **Grand Theft Auto** series for years, this situation presents a complex picture. The overwhelming critical praise suggests that **GTA 6** is a monumental achievement, yet the vocal minority of negative user reviews cannot be entirely dismissed. It raises questions about evolving player expectations, the definition of 'fun' versus 'artistic merit,' and the influence of online discourse on a game's perceived value. The debate is likely to continue as more players experience the game, but the initial user score controversy has undeniably added a layer of drama to **GTA 6**'s otherwise triumphant release.

## What's Next

While the embargo for professional reviews has lifted, **GTA 6** is still some time away from its official release on consoles. Players will need to wait until its launch to form their own comprehensive opinions, and it will be fascinating to see how the user scores evolve thereafter. Details regarding potential post-launch content or updates have not yet been announced.
